messages.subject: International Energy & Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear AP GlobalEnergy Team,

Your international work across energy, infrastructure, commodities and industrial markets, including cross-border recruitment and relocation support, makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where responsible development, institutional trust, regulatory execution and operating strategy converge. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, alongside wider GCC and international opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration. I would welcome inclusion in relevant energy, resources, ESG, external affairs and country leadership searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
